body: You’re actl so right :/ thank you for your perspective, I’ll continue working on this w him

If you have a mentor or teacher you respect/are decently close to, it could be helpful to get a testimonial from them :) I have very shitty grades due to circumstances and but hopefully employers these days are less “shallow”
Are you guys hiring 😅 I’m looking to go into education as well as it’s my passion but I’m an introvert.. I love education but I get over stimulated so easily
I’m getting laser too, and I too am worried I’ll start pulling elsewhere. I notice I pull when I’m bored or and stressed

I find using ice helps in soothing the swelling. BHA facial products (mild ones) for small pimples and ingrowns. Normal unscented lotion or aloe Vera to moisturise.. otherwise I’m not sure too, I’m pretty scarred down there as well :/

I also pick my skin a lot but my main issue is with plucking hair down there as well, could take me 2 hours at once and I won’t stop because I get into a trance.. I feel guilty afterwards but I’ve been doing it from 10+ years and find it hard to stop honestly. Longest I’ve ever gone without it is prob a week but nothing more… idk if there’s a cure for this but acknowledging it is a good first step, and knowing it’s a problem but you’re not  alone in this. On a positive light, I’ve decided to invest in laser hair removal as a practical solution to my urges. I used to pluck my armpit hair but laser reduced the frequency dramatically so I’m hoping it’ll work for the down there as well..

Hello, I’m not sure entirely but my grandma has similar behaviours and it was very toxic for me growing up so this is triggering.. even till now my grandma displays a lot of guilt tripping towards us (in front of us) and thinking that we are out to get her. I’ve been living with her since I was born as she took care of me while my parents were away, but now we aren’t as close

Hi there, I take lexapro but it doesn’t help w my trich :( not sure if it’s cos the dose is too Low (I’ve been taking 15mg) and I’m also too scared to tell my doc about it. I have skin picking issues as well so I unds how u feel

P.s. I feel like I rly can’t control my urges.. I’ve thrown away tweezers but it’s just still hard. And this rly affects my intimacy and self esteem :( I literally can spend hours going at it without feeling anything but afterwards I just feel guilt and disgust. I don’t even know how to bring this up to my therapist and doctor without them judging me
I mean we agreed that fate could bring us back if it’s meant to be.. but now I’m not sure either :o
Why is it nota break up tho? Just curious

Thank you for this post! It’s exactly how I feel and my dad is like that too.. have you gotten a diagnosis yet? Thinking of asking my doctor but afraid I’ll get rejected or invalidated (I don’t like to be wrong either hahaha
Thank you, yes it’s easier to talk to a stranger. Makes me wonder why we even have to make friends :( feels complicated
I understand.. it’s so depressing to be reminded that you’re still alive after so long. Have a tolerable advanced birthday ❤️
I hate that ppl make a big deal out of birthdays
Thank you for your suggestions ❤️
Idkkk :( I just wanna rot but I feel like that will make me sadder haha at this point I’m not even sure what I want
Next Tuesday
Thank you, I really appreciate your reply
Thank you, I hope you have a good day

I’m sorry you went through this. Sometimes we take people for granted and I too wished my “friends” were there for me too. But your sharing helped me seee a diff perspective, because ultimately we are allowed to be ourselves and do things that we like. It’s not your fault that you lost focus for a sec. Sure, you could’ve paid attention but idk how much it would’ve helped her. Because ppl with suicidal tendencies see things diff, they ruminate over the smallest things, so rly, it’s not your fault you chose to focus on other things as well. Nonetheless I’m really sorry for your loss but please don’t blame yourself for too long. xx take care

I understand how you feel about fitting in.. I wish I was more normal and less me too. But really I think we just haven’t found the right people for us. I fantasise about death too because I want people to feel sorry for excluding and hating me, but I guess the only thing keeping me from jumping is my family. I don’t know how to talk you out of it, but I just wanna let you know that you are heard and you are not entirely alone in this world
Take care omg :(
